page.title: Memory
page.description: Short facts Toskar keeps about you and your work, such as your preferences, projects, and the people you mention. They carry across chats and models, and stay on this computer.
page.useInChatsHint: Off keeps every memory, but chats don't use them.
page.off: Memory is off. Chats do not use what is saved here, and nothing is deleted.
page.emptyDescription: Tell Toskar things worth keeping, such as “Remember that I prefer metric units” or “Remember that this project uses Go.”

intro.title: How memory works

tell.title: Tell it once
tell.body: Say “Remember that …” in any chat, or add a memory here.

fit.title: It's used when it fits
fit.body: Before each answer, Toskar picks the memories that fit the question. They work with every model.

control.title: You stay in control
control.body: Edit, pause, or delete any memory. Turn memory off for one chat in its Options, or for every chat here.

intro.knowledge: Memory is for short facts. For documents and data, use <go>Knowledge</go>.

examples.title: Try one
examples.short: Keep answers short, with an example.
examples.language: I'm learning Spanish, so explain words I might not know.
examples.shop: I run a small online shop.

add.label: Add a memory
add.placeholder: I prefer short answers with examples

row.languageHint: Written in this language. With an embedding model installed, Toskar finds it whatever language you ask in.
row.localOnlyHint: Never send this memory to a paired computer. Chats that use it run here.
